caveats: Engine = Mistral mistral-embed (not necessarily final deploy model); directional only.
Ground truth = owner эталон XLSX (corrected path). Only 57 of 517 эталон rows carry ANY analog answer.
Of those 57 analog rows, 42 map to spec rows that are ALREADY MATCHED in prod (not in the 301 empty set) — i.e. the эталон answers the EASY rows, which the matcher already solved.
Join эталон<->empty by normalized-name dice>=0.5. Bare-Ø эталон rows resolved with parent context.
In-pool answer resolution: AYVAZ by DN, НЗВЗ by price(±2%)+name tiebreak, ОБМ by code, SANEXT by best name-dice (SANEXT brand has NO loaded invoice).
The 301 empty rows are dominated by products with NO эталон analog answer at all (286 rows) — duct fittings, fans, vent units, split EI/S= attribute fragments.
accuracy_note: STRICT (exact size-correct item)=1/12; GENEROUS (correct product family, size-blind)=6/12. Both << GO threshold of 50.
